rows.mce:eu-marketing-support-manager:
EU Marketing Support Manager Location based
UK, France, Germany or central area of Europe.
Work independently most of the time
Your role
1. Research and collect information on the European biopharmaceutical market, competing products, conferences and exhibitions, new products and other relevant information and provide feedback to the head office marketing team.
2. Represent MedChemExpress (MCE) as an exhibitor at academic conferences, exhibitions and vendor shows to increase brand awareness and expand market share.
3. Research and develop major industrial customers (e.g. big pharma, Biotech, etc.) and platform customers in major European markets such as UK, Germany, France, Austria, Switzerland, etc. and work with local sales teams to visit and maintain customers and promote the achievement of sales targets for industrial customers.
4. Other activities related to MedChemExpress (MCE) marketing.
Required Skills
1. Bachelor degree or above, major in pharmacy, biology, biochemistry, biomedicine, etc. Excellent knowledge of life sciences products.
2. At least 2 years sales experience in life science products.
3. Fluent in English. Multilingual learners are preferred.
4. Open-minded, result-motivated, strong learning ability, excellent communication skills and teamwork spirit are required.
5. Positive and stable professional mentality, able to withstand greater work pressure. Adapt to weekly in-person customer visits.
6. A clear understanding of the biopharmaceutical industry and key corporate clients in key European markets, particularly in the UK, Germany and France.
7. Adaptable to multi-cultural teamwork.
8. Be able to work independently to achieve sales targets and is good at organizing work plans to achieve sales targets.
What you will get in return
1. Full support from local based MedChemExpress (MCE) team.
2. Comprehensive training program offered.

rows.mce:mandarin-bi-lingual-purchasing-logis:
Mandarin Bi-lingual Purchasing & Logistics Specialist Location based
Monmouth Junction, NJ 08852
Your role
1. Procurement Receiving & Inventory Entry
• Receive chemical products in accordance with purchase orders and accurately record receiving information in data tracking tables.
• Promptly report any discrepancies or abnormalities to purchasing colleagues and follow up on resolution actions as instructed.
• Track procurement packages and Manage customs clearance when needed.
• Determine and execute product disposition based on the purpose of the purchase order.
• Complete system inventory entry for stocked or order-related products; These products require repackaging and some need aliquoting.
2. Intercompany Stock Transfer & Fulfillment
• Arrange products from NJ warehouse to affiliated warehouses as requested.
• Handle shipment fulfillment on behalf of sister companies for their North America customers.
3. Shipments to Shanghai
Arrange and ship the following items to Shanghai as required:
• Procured products;
• Intercompany transfer products;
• Customer samples and customer-order-related vials.
4. Procurement Inventory Management
• Complete inventory entry for procured products and maintain accurate records to ensure full traceability.
• Manage and maintain designated storage locations on a Weekly basis, ensuring proper documentation and organization.
• Handle and resolve any special or exceptional situations arising in the course of the above responsibilities.
Required Skills
1. Bilingual in Chinese and English: Ability to work effectively in both languages.
2. Detail-oriented and responsible: The team handles high-value products and currently lacks system support; many details require manual verification (double-checking), so accuracy and carefulness are essential.
3. Proficient in Excel and email: Skills in commonly used Excel functions and formulas; familiar with email platforms and typical operations.
4. Strong learning ability: Able to quickly understand order information, system functions and structures, and operational workflows.
5. Stable and committed: Demonstrates reliability and willingness to work long-term.

rows.mce:sales-representative-manager:
Sales Representative/Manager Full Job Description
This is a full-time position with career advancement opportunities within the company. You must be available to work from Monday to Friday and willing to travel.
MedChemExpress (MCE) is a renowned globally company in the chemicals and biochemicals research market specializing in the development of novel life-science reagents, reference compounds, APIs and natural compounds, and MedChemExpress (MCE) is rapidly expanding its sales team to further develop more customers.
Location based
Belgium, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Netherlands, Spain, UK, Hong Kong, Switzerland
Your role
1. Ability to work independently to achieve sales growth and reach sales target for the MedChemExpress (MCE) product line in your sales area.
2. Promote MedChemExpress (MCE) brand and products in the responsible sales area.
3. Ability to interact well with customers and maintain good customer relationships, visit customers regularly, develop new customers, being professional and courteous.
4. Ability to professionally receive customer calls, chats and emails regarding orders and technical questions.
5. Ability to communicate accurate information regarding products, prices, product availability, and current promotions to customers.
6. Ability to work as an effective team player to ensure the highest level of efficiency and success for the team.
7. Cooperate with BD manager and marketing manager to participate in product branding and marketing events.
8. Ability to collect local market and industry information, do market research and share with the team to help with marketing strategies and plans.
9. Excellent business communications skills (verbal, written, presentation), organizational skills and computer skills.
10. Capacity to monitor and engage in relevant social discussions about our company, competitors, and/or industry, both from existing customers and leads for new audiences.
11. Accept customer inquiries and build customer files; follow up order processing and delivery; provide after-sale service.
12. Attend exhibitions, scientific conference, trade shows; develop marketing campaign; collect customer information.
Required Skills
1. Bachelor's degree or above in life science, Bioscience, Biology, Pharmacy, chemistry, drug chemistry, biochemistry and related disciplines.
2. Familiarity with biological or biomedical or biochemical or pharmaceutical industry, at least one year of relevant working experience (Preferred).
3. Willing to engage in sales work; can withstand certain work pressure.
4. Friendly and talkative, open-minded, strong sense of responsibility.
5. Good communication skills, ambition, strong customer service awareness.
6. Fluent in the local language and English, both oral and written.
7. High level of self-motivation and perseverance.
What you will get in return
1. Full support from local based MedChemExpress (MCE) team.
2. Onboarding training and weekly sales training program offered.
3. Basic salary plus sales commission and new customer development rewards; Uncapped earning potential.
Please submit a cover letter and resume to apply for this position (MS Word or pdf files).

rows.mce:sales-specialist-in-the-antibody-pro:
Sales Specialist in the Antibody Product Line Location based
California, Arizona, Utah, Colorado// Maryland, Pennsylvania, Delaware, New Jersey
Your role
We are looking for a candidate who has a solid knowledge of biology, desire to be successful, is enthusiastic, and can learn. The ability to communicate with a customer on a technical level about the customer’s needs for our products and services is a necessary starting point that needs to be sharpened on a continuous basis. Enthusiasm and a desire to meet new customers and gain their trust are traits that our successful reps share. This position will require regular field trips to visit customers.
Required Skills
1. Bachelor’s Degree in Life Science (We will consider new graduates), candidates with advanced degrees are preferred.
2. Ideally 2 years of sales experiences and/or 2 years of experiences in biomedical research, candidates with protein and biologics sales experience are preferred.
3. Desire to establish a long term career.
4. Ability to establish rapport with a wide variety of people.
5. Ability to analyze sales data and present informative sales reports.
6. Has valid US driver’s license and can drive.
